Veterans Benefits: Texas offers qualifying disabled veterans property-tax exemptions; the Hazlewood Act provides up to 150 hours of tuition exemption for qualified veterans and eligible family members; Texas also operates state veterans homes and other veteran programs. Texas has no individual state income tax, so military retirement pay is not subject to Texas personal income tax.

Description: Fort Stockton is a small West Texas city and the Pecos County seat with about 8,000 residents, relatively inexpensive housing, no Texas individual income tax, and a VA outpatient clinic in town. It has a hot, dry semi-arid climate and functions as a regional center for government, medical care, and retail services, while local tourism emphasizes historic sites, museums, and outdoor recreation.
